chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The heart is the book of the eye.

key_terms.الْبَصَرِ: The eye or sight, referring to physical or spiritual vision
key_terms.الْقَلْبُ: The heart, considered the center of spiritual perception and intellect
key_terms.مُصْحَفُ: A manuscript, book, or codex; here used metaphorically for a repository of knowledge

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of the heart in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this profound metaphor from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) identifies the heart (qalb) as the 'manuscript of vision,' suggesting that true perception transcends physical sight to encompass spiritual insight (basirah). This concept aligns with the Shia tradition of the heart as the locus of divine knowledge, where the intellect and intuition converge to record and comprehend higher realities beyond the material realm.
